name: Gen1BillsBox
description: Replaces Bill's PC with a box you can see, and puts a BOX row on the START menu so you can reach it without one in front of you: the party down the left, the open box as a 5x4 grid on the right, and a cursor that picks a POKeMON up and puts it down. Drawn in the Game Boy's own font and black line art, with the party menu's own icons in every slot -- so a menu-icon mod shows up here too -- and a palette zone per cell, so every POKeMON in the box wears its own species colours where the Game Boy could show four at once -- while authored full-colour icons from an icon mod are left exactly as their author drew them. The cursor is an arrow over a POKeMON's head, hollow while one is in hand. A POKeMON caught into a full box says which box it actually went to, and the open box follows it there. Boxes are a real grid: a POKeMON picked up leaves its cell empty and can be put down in any empty one, and the POKeMON in your hand slowly flashes. The party takes gaps too while the box is open, and is a list of six again the moment you leave. SELECT sorts the open box by dex, level, name or type, or just closes its gaps up, with one step of undo. The PC's storage rows are renamed BILL'S BOX and SOMEONE'S BOX.
